datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field assessments across Mozambique to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data with IPC phase classifications and scenario projections were compiled for near-term forecasting during 2019, with multiple monthly snapshots representing evolving food security conditions.
